top_signals.title: Ares CEO Sees Growing Demand for Private Credit in Asia
top_signals.summary: Ares Management CEO and Co-Founder Michael Arougheti says Asia’s private-credit market is not yet large enough to meet demand as global investors increasingly look to the region. He spoke to Yvonne Man and David Ingles on the sidelines of the HKMA Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)
